title: LLM Provider Response Envelope
description: OpenAI-compatible chat completion envelope as returned by the configured provider (Groq initially). The article JSON itself is embedded as a string in choices[0].message.content and must be parsed and validated separately against article.schema.json by article-response-normalizer.

content.description: MUST be valid JSON parseable into article.schema.json. A non-JSON value here is a normalization_failed condition, not a partial-recovery opportunity.
